finding.title: Wire functions/test/cf_*.test.mjs and a functions build step into CI

evidence.quote: test-functions: ## Run Cloud Functions tests (real handlers vs firestore emulator) (L5)
ci: analyze validate-calendar test ## Run full CI pipeline (analyze + seed validation + all tests)

// Remaining gates and happy paths for acceptTutorInvite/declineTutorInvite are
// skipped here and documented as requiring the Auth emulator.

finding.why: functions/src/index.ts is 2029 lines of Admin-SDK-privileged, rules-bypassing server code -- the highest-privilege code in the repo -- yet no CI job builds, type-checks, or tests it. `make ci` runs only `analyze validate-calendar test` (Flutter side); `test-functions` (which runs the 7 cf_*.test.mjs files, 3,236 lines) and `npm --prefix functions run build` are only reachable via a developer manually typing the make target. This is distinct from the already-known 'make ci doesn't run test-rules' gap (that's the separate firestore_rules.test.mjs suite, which does have a dedicated CI job) -- functions/ has no CI path of any kind. A PR that reintroduces the P0 auth gap above, or any other Cloud Function regression, or a plain TypeScript compile error, gets a green CI check.
finding.recommendation: Add a `functions` CI job (parallel to the existing `firestore-rules` job) running `npm --prefix functions run build` then `firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-cf "node --test --test-concurrency=1 functions/test/cf_*.test.mjs"`, mirroring `make test-functions`; fold `test-functions` into `make ci` locally; add a `"test"` script to functions/package.json.
acceptance_criteria: CI fails the PR when any functions/test/cf_*.test.mjs test fails or functions/src fails to compile.
